# Third-party licences

Generated from package-lock.json and uv.lock; metadata and artifact hashes are in docs/license-inventory.json. Unmodified dependencies are guaranteed by installing registry artifacts through integrity/hash-pinned lockfiles (npm ci and uv sync --locked --no-build) and vendoring no MPL packages. This is not an installed-tree modification audit. Python installation uses binary wheels only (no unrecorded build backend). Browser binaries are test tools, not distributed with the product.
